page_title: WOL 1-2 BAY | Wolfsburg v Bayern Munich 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Thomas Tuchel decides to make a substitution. Jamal Musiala will be replaced by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich).
90+3' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Manuel Neuer makes a comfortable save.
90+1' It must be a yellow card. It is. Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
90+1' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) has tested the patience of referee Sascha Stegemann and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
88' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
85' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) will replace Ridle Baku.
81' Koen Casteels reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) towards the middle of the goal.
81' A clumsy foul by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle.

79' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
76' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.
76' The attendance for today's match is 28000.
74' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
74' Bayern Munich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
73' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick, but Koen Casteels reads it well and stops the effort.

73' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
72' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
72' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) replaces Mattias Svanberg.
67' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) plays a through ball but overhits it.
63' That will be all from Thomas Muller who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich).
59' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
59' Rogerio (Wolfsburg) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Manuel Neuer pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
57' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
53' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
53' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle after Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
52' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lovro Majer will be replaced by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
49' The corner from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is hurriedly cleared.
49' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.
48' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayern Munich.
46' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Sascha Stegemann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) is replaced by Rogerio.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Joakim Maehle plays a short, square pass into the path of Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg), who bends a shot straight into the left side of the goal to make it 1:2. Fabulous goal!
45+1' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Bayern Munich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee blows his whistle, Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.

43' 0 - 2 Nice piece of skill by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich). He perfectly collected a pass from Thomas Muller, then unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the top right corner. The score is 0:2.
38' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

33' 0 - 1 Thomas Muller sends a superb cross into the box. Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the right post, leaving Koen Casteels beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 0:1.
32' What a chance that is! Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
28' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
26' A first-time shot by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
25' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
25' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) makes a slide tackle, but referee Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul.
23' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick but it's straight at the goalkeeper.
20' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) for his blatant foul.
20' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' The ball is cleared after Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
15' A pass into the penalty area from Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is intercepted by the defence.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich).
13' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
11' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sascha Stegemann had an easy-decision to make.

9' What a wasted opportunity by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Koen Casteels makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
7' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
6' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) climbs above the defence to meet the free kick, but plants his header high over the bar from close range.

5' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Sascha Stegemann blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
4' The shot by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Manuel Neuer.

2' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Sascha Stegemann.
